dashboard.hero_lead: Learn numerical methods through real interactive computation, not just theory.
dashboard.next_desc: Enter a function, interval, and precision. The system will show every step of approaching the root.

bisection.hero_lead: Guaranteed convergence to the root by halving the interval at each step.
bisection.map_1_s: Check signs of f(a) and f(b)
bisection.map_3_s: Select the subinterval with the root
bisection.note_fn: function — the equation to solve. Example:
bisection.err_fn: Check the expression to display the formula
bisection.note_eps: Precision — stop when interval length is less than this.
bisection.plot_empty: Enter a valid function and a < b for the plot
bisection.trace_empty_desc: Enter parameters on the left, then click the button.

euler.hero_lead: Compare standard and improved Euler methods with the analytical solution, observing the difference at each step.
euler.plot_exact_note: Exact solution is only available for the equation f(x, y) = x − 2y.
euler.method_simple_desc: Derivative is evaluated at the current point.
euler.exact_desc: C = y₀ − x₀/2 + 1/4; with standard initial values C = 7/4.
euler.steps_desc: intervals, final step is adjusted to the boundary.

newton.hero_lead: Method of tangents. Uses the derivative for ultra-fast (quadratic) convergence to the root.

simpson.hero_lead: Parabolic rule. Numerically evaluate definite integrals using quadratic interpolation with high precision.
simpson.hero_condSub: The number of subintervals 'n' must be an even integer
simpson.map_1_s: Interval is divided into n equal parts: h = (b - a) / n.
simpson.map_1_desc: Interval is divided into n equal parts:
simpson.map_2_s: Endpoints, odd, and even index function values are separated.
simpson.note_fn: Integrand expression (e.g. dx / sqrt(1 + 2x^2), sin(x), x^2).
simpson.plot_empty: Enter valid bounds and expression to plot the curve and integral area.

trapezoid.hero_lead: Approximate the integrand linearly between nodes and calculate every trapezoid area step by step.
trapezoid.hero_condition: The integrand is approximated linearly on each subinterval.
trapezoid.map_2_desc: Calculate xᵢ and f(xᵢ) for each node
trapezoid.note_fn: Use Math.js syntax. Expressions containing dx are also accepted:
trapezoid.plot_empty: Enter a function and bounds with a < b to plot.
trapezoid.step_nodes_desc: Each node is found with xᵢ = a + i·h, then f(xᵢ) is evaluated.
trapezoid.benchmark_note: The benchmark is not an analytical exact integral: as in the V2 version, it is a higher-resolution approximation computed by the trapezoidal rule with n = {count} subintervals.
trapezoid.empty_desc: Enter the parameters on the left. The result will show nodes, each trapezoid area, their sum, and the comparison steps.
trapezoid.footer: Trapezoidal rule · Piecewise linear interpolation over n equal subintervals

rectangle.hero_lead: Calculate areas from endpoint function values, then compare the left, right, averaged rectangle sums, and trapezoidal estimate.
rectangle.hero_condition: Average the left and right sums for a balanced approximation.
rectangle.note_fn: Use Math.js syntax. Expressions containing dx are also accepted:
rectangle.plot_empty: Enter a function and bounds with a < b to plot.
rectangle.step_nodes_desc: Find each node using xᵢ = a + i·h and evaluate f(xᵢ).
rectangle.benchmark_note: The benchmark is not an analytical exact integral: as in V2, it is a higher-resolution approximation using the trapezoidal rule with n = {count} subintervals.
rectangle.error_note: Errors are measured against the higher-resolution benchmark. This benchmark is not an analytical exact value.
rectangle.empty_desc: Enter the parameters. The result will show left, right, and averaged sums, every rectangle step, and a comparison.
rectangle.footer: Left/right rectangles · Mean value · Trapezoid comparison

errors.nwt_fn: Invalid function or derivative could not be found.
errors.nwt_deriv_zero: Error: derivative became zero (f'(x) ≈ 0) at step {iter}.
errors.nwt_no_root: Root not found within {max} iterations. The method may not converge from this starting point.
errors.bis_undef: Function is undefined at the given points.
errors.bis_same_sign: Signs of f(a) and f(b) are the same: f(a)={fa}, f(b)={fb}. Root bracketing requires f(a)·f(b) < 0.
errors.bis_done: Interval length is less than ε — calculation stopped.
errors.bis_left: Signs of f(a) and f(c) are opposite. Root is in the left half.
errors.bis_right: Signs of f(c) and f(b) are opposite. Root is in the right half.
errors.bis_dec_left: Since f(a) · f(c) < 0, new interval [a, c] = {interval}
errors.bis_dec_right: Since f(c) · f(b) < 0, new interval [c, b] = {interval}
errors.elr_params: Please enter all parameters as numbers.
errors.elr_bounds: x_end must be greater than x₀, and step h must be > 0.
errors.elr_max: The number of steps must not exceed 1000.
errors.elr_syntax: Check function syntax. Use Math.js syntax.
errors.elr_finite: f({x}, {y}) is not a finite number.
errors.smp_params: Invalid parameters. Please check your numerical inputs.
errors.smp_bounds: Lower bound (a) must be strictly less than upper bound (b) (a < b).
errors.smp_positive: Subintervals count (n) must be a positive integer.
errors.smp_eval: Could not evaluate f({x}) or function evaluated to infinity/NaN.
errors.trap_params: Enter numeric values for a, b, and n; n must be an integer.
errors.trap_bounds: The lower bound a must be less than the upper bound b.
errors.trap_positive: The number of subintervals n must be at least 1.
errors.trap_max: The number of subintervals must not exceed {max}.
errors.trap_fn: Check the function expression and use Math.js syntax.
errors.trap_eval: Could not evaluate f({x}); the function must be defined on the interval.
errors.rect_params: Enter numeric values for a, b, and n; n must be an integer.
errors.rect_bounds: The lower bound a must be less than the upper bound b.
errors.rect_positive: The number of subintervals n must be at least 1.
errors.rect_max: The number of subintervals must not exceed {max}.
errors.rect_fn: Check the function expression and use Math.js syntax.
errors.rect_eval: Could not evaluate f({x}); the function must be defined on the whole interval.

syntax.hero_lead: For the program to work correctly, all expressions (formulas) must be written in strict accordance with Math.js syntax.
